Fit track-length velocity models per group

Source: R/track_velocity.R
fit_track_length_models.Rd

Run fit_track_velocity_linear() separately for each level of group_col and stack the result tables. Group i uses hold-out seed seed + i.

Usage

fit_track_length_models(
  data,
  group_col = "state",
  levels = NULL,
  seed = 2026L,
  n_grid = 200L,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

Output of summarize_track_lengths() with a grouping column.

group_col

Grouping column.

levels

Group levels to fit (in this order); default: sorted unique values.

seed

Base seed of the hold-out splits.

n_grid

Number of prediction points per group (e.g. 200).

...

Further arguments of fit_track_velocity_linear() (level, quantile, holdout_prop, fit_seed, positive_velocity_only, min_cells, min_distinct, sort_by_rep).

Value

A list with state_models (per-group results), has_quantreg, and the stacked tables model_data, model_prediction, linear_residuals, robust_residuals, validation, validation_metrics and model_comparison, each with group_col as a factor.
